settings.history: One growing isolated SQLite history; one run per revision; independent heat input = 500 + 10*(revision-1) after revision 1

reproduction: Or run both consecutively: tools/run_python.cmd tools/benchmark_workspace_history.py

method.timed_scope: Public store method only; new-store mode includes constructor; excludes JSON serialization, digest collection and explicit post-checkpoint verification
method.warm_read: Same WorkspaceStore instance already used to build this history
method.new_store_read: New WorkspaceStore instance for every read in same child process; OS/filesystem caches not flushed
method.save_run_summary: Cumulative one sample per revision up to each checkpoint; latest_save/latest_run are also retained
method.identity_control: Same fixed _now() and sequential UUID(int=n) in both subprocesses; no other workspace/model logic replaced
method.source_control: Immutable git-archive baseline with matching kernels; current copied source with CRLF normalized to LF; active source never swapped
method.payload: Complete public returned view as sorted compact ensure_ascii JSON UTF-8 bytes; transport/gzip costs excluded
method.verification_counts: Instrument lifecycle.verify_review and WorkspaceStore._receipt equally in both source subprocesses
method.run_order: Before phase precedes after; no process import crossover; same Python executable; no CPU affinity or load control

limitations: Finite constructed local history and this machine only; elapsed timing is descriptive and has no pass threshold.
New-store reads are cold for application object caches only; they are not cold-process or cold-disk measurements.
Review verification checks internal evidence consistency; it does not recompute or prove orbital physics.
The retained orbital grid is fixed by settings.steps; no mission accuracy, hardware or production scale claim follows.
Database/payload size and serialization costs remain visible and can grow; paid model, network and multi-user server latency are excluded.
Fixed clock/UUID and instrumentation add the same small overhead to each phase; other offline tests may run on this shared machine, which is not dedicated idle hardware.
This fixed 512-step default is a bounded scaling probe; it does not reproduce another reviewer's unknown orbital resolution or wall-clock timings.

source_provenance.normalization: CRLF -> LF in isolated candidate copy only; active source is untouched
